verdict.rationale: GitHub explicitly markets CI/CD ('Ship faster with secure, reliable CI/CD') and provides an official CLI (gh) that is commonly used in scripts/CI pipelines, both fitting headless automation use cases. However, the evidence pack lacks detailed documentation of GitHub Actions workflow syntax, headless agent/Copilot CLI usage, or independent corroboration of running Copilot/agents in CI. Missing for 10: detailed Actions/workflow docs, evidence of Copilot or agent mode running non-interactively in CI, independent hands-on confirmation.
